name: Shifter Creature (CR +1 or +2)
body:
A shifter creature gains shapechanging powers and some other druidic abilities. A shifter creature’s CR increases by 2 if the creature has 7 or more HD.

Quick Rules

+2 on all rolls based on Str and Wis; can use shifter aspect for a number of minutes per day equal to 3 + ½ its HD (choosing only one aspect; the creature uses its HD as its shifter level to determine the bonuses granted); can use wild shape (if it has 7 or more HD, using its HD –3 as its shifter level to determine the duration and effect of the wild shape); gains defensive instinct (treating its HD as its shifter levels to determine the bonus) and track.

Rebuild Rules

Defensive Abilities defensive instinct (treating its HD as its shifter levels to determine the bonus); Special Attacks shifter aspect for a number of minutes per day equal to 3 + ½ its HD (choosing only one aspect; the creature uses its HD as its shifter level to determine the bonuses granted), wild shape (if it has 7 or more HD, using its HD –3 as its shifter level to determine the duration and effects); Special Qualities track; Ability Scores +4 Strength and Wisdom.
